name.description: Official Spanish name of the medical faculty

has_unit.description: Does the university or its teaching hospital have a rheumatology unit/department?

has_postgrad_programme.description: Does it run a rheumatology specialty programme (beca/especialidad)?

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim Spanish text proving the above. Empty if unknown.

careers_page_url.description: The page where academic vacancies / concursos académicos are published. Must be the real page, not the homepage.

open_positions_found.description: Number of currently open academic vacancies found, -1 if the page could not be read

positions_note.description: What is currently open, incl. any medicine/internal-medicine post. Say 'none open today' plainly if so.

requires_chilean_title_note.description: What the published requisitos actually say about foreign titles, revalidación, or nationality. Quote if possible.

english_taught_any.description: Does it teach ANY medical course in English?

notes.description: International/visiting academic programmes, exchange, foreign faculty presence

profile_paragraphs.description: 3-5 short factual paragraphs IN ENGLISH about this university's medical faculty: what it is, when founded, where, reputation/ranking if sourced, teaching hospital, notable strengths, and anything that matters to a foreign rheumatologist considering it. Each paragraph max 400 characters. Facts only, each traceable to a source below.
